title: lobelia gibbosa var. browniana
intro: Lobelia gibbosa var. browniana, commonly known as Brown's lobelia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. It is an herb used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Brown's lobelia include stimulating the respiratory system, promoting the clearance of mucus, and acting as a bronchodilator. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
